# Fluso

> Fluso is a proactive AI workspace — a desktop app for macOS and Windows that brings an AI agent with full context, complete control, and deep focus to everything you do. It runs on open-weight models and keeps your data within your own boundary.

## Product

- [Agents](https://fluso.ai/#agents): Agents with instructions, files, connected apps and scheduled routines, included in every plan.
- [Italiano](https://fluso.ai/it/): The Italian marketing website.

Free costs $0. Plus costs $10/user/month and includes 10× Free weekly usage. Pro costs $30/user/month and includes 10× Plus weekly usage and confidential mode. All three allowances reset weekly. Eligible 30-day Pro trials require a payment card and renew at $30/month unless cancelled.


- [Home](https://fluso.ai/): Overview of Fluso — full context, complete control, deep focus, open-weight models.
- [Download](https://fluso.ai/download): Get the Fluso desktop app for macOS or Windows.
- [Get Started](https://fluso.ai/get-started): Install Fluso and put your proactive AI agent to work on your first project.
- [Pricing](https://fluso.ai/pricing): Fluso plans and pricing.
- [Enterprise](https://fluso.ai/enterprise): Fluso for enterprise teams.

## Use Cases

- [For Founders](https://fluso.ai/for-founders): An agent for founders — investor updates, hiring inbox, and data rooms handled while you build.
- [For Sales Teams](https://fluso.ai/for-sales): An agent for sellers — account research, follow-ups, and CRM hygiene done before your first coffee.
- [For Marketers](https://fluso.ai/for-marketers): An agent for marketers — briefs, performance reads, and asset trafficking handled off your plate.
- [For Lawyers](https://fluso.ai/for-lawyers): An agent for lawyers, built around Fluso's proactive AI workspace.
- [For Doctors](https://fluso.ai/for-doctors): An agent for doctors, built around Fluso's proactive AI workspace.
- [For Researchers](https://fluso.ai/for-researchers): An agent for researchers — literature review, citation work, and formatting handed off so you can think.
- [For Consultants](https://fluso.ai/for-consultants): An agent for consultants — decks, models, and the synthesis grind handled with rigor.
- [For Investors](https://fluso.ai/for-investors): An agent for investors — sourcing, diligence, and portfolio monitoring running while you take the next meeting.
- [For Operations Teams](https://fluso.ai/for-operations): An agent for operators — vendor reviews, invoice routing, and ticket triage across every tool you use.
